morbi.headline: Morbi faces operational stress with unit shutdowns, high inventory, and rising fuel costs
what_changed: Morbi ceramic production cycle slowed down, resulting in full warehouses of unsold stock and 15% of units shutting down
Attempts to mitigate or control elevated propane gas prices have failed, increasing operational challenges
Proposed ceramic testing laboratory for Bikaner's 200 clay mines is being relocated to Jaipur due to building possession delays
stress_signals: 15% of ceramic manufacturing units have shut down due to high inventory and production slowdowns [64076d83f199]
Rising propane gas prices remain uncontrolled, straining operational costs for cluster units [64076d83f199]

surat.headline: Surat textiles face severe cost, labor, and liquidity shocks while diamond manufacturing rebounds.
what_changed: Surat weavers instituted two-day weekly production cuts to manage costly yarn, weak grey fabric demand, and strict 15-day pre-Diwali yarn payment rules.
Labor disruptions escalated with a two-month agitation, demands for 8-hour workdays and weekly offs, and an intensified 'Gaon Chalo' early exodus.
Textile operating costs spiked due to a 66% yarn price hike and doubled coal prices, which drove a reported 50% drop in trade.
The diamond industry bucked seasonal slowdowns by cutting Diwali vacation duration for the first time in four years amid improved demand.
stress_signals: Steep input spikes (66% yarn hike, doubled coal prices) and weak realizations forced weaving capacity cuts and drove a 50% drop in textile trade [b62552cc0c7d, 16a5b570eb9e, 161041af6dcb, d81a5c760dad].
Cash flow and working capital squeeze accelerated by mandatory 15-day yarn payment terms ahead of Diwali amid recessionary demand [0c72a246c955, 57e5e152a5cb, 28ff6df05700].

Extensive labor unrest, including the 'Gaon Chalo' movement and two-month agitations for higher wages and regulated hours, risking premature Diwali production shutdowns [ce4764831b1f, a9383cbae2cf, 73dfcce5d3f4, b0d8a5269e4e].
Trade counterparty credit risks highlighted by a Rs 15.57 crore textile fraud arrest and a FOSTTA advisory cautioning traders against new agents [cf2229091691, 9013ae33515c].
improvement_signals: Diamond cutting and polishing units shortened traditional Diwali vacations for the first time in four years due to revived demand [2b47ff4fa01a].
Cluster infrastructure gained from ICA-GemLab establishing a testing laboratory and MANTRA positioning Surat as a textile testing hub [26bd1ecd549c, 0b9a805766c6].
High-altitude testing of a locally manufactured fabric-coated balloon airship highlighted technical textile manufacturing capabilities [5a6c6ad01d9d].
what_to_watch: Working capital drawings and overdue positions among weaving borrowers enforcing 2-day shutdowns and meeting 15-day yarn settlement rules.
Labor attendance and festive capacity utilization levels following worker agitations and the 'Gaon Chalo' early migration wave.
Trade receivables aging and debtor concentration to detect exposure to new intermediaries following the FOSTTA caution notice and Rs 15.57 crore fraud.
Compliance friction and operational overheads following directives to file returns on the Textile Statistical Returns System (TSRS) portal.
